_sheet: Card picker UI (uGUI, built at runtime, no asset bundle). One row = one UI element. Generated/UiLayout.cs gets a static class per row with its Size, Text template and every entry of consts (numbers become float consts, 4-number arrays become Colors, strings become string consts). Fonts: the game's own TMP font found at runtime; card colours come from cards.json themes and the art from art.json.

_columns.visual: what it looks like, in words
_columns.consts: named numbers / colours / strings the code needs for this element

canvas.fontNote: every mod text uses this font (assets/fonts, shipped next to the DLL; SIL Open Font License); the game's own font is its fallback, and the whole UI falls back to it when the file is missing or UI.CustomFont is off. Darumadrop One has one heavy weight: bold is synthesised, so fontBoldStyle and fontBoldSpacing keep TMP's faux bold light (TMP defaults 0.75 and 7 clog its counters at small sizes). Line heights in rows are multiples of the font size; the code converts them for whichever font is in use
canvas.scaleNote: CanvasScaler ScaleWithScreenSize, match 0.5. Config General.UiScale multiplies it (0 = auto: 1, or smallScreenScale on screens at most smallScreenHeight pixels tall, such as a Steam Deck). Layouts that could outgrow the screen (card fan, Current Build) measure the canvas and keep safeMargin from every edge

palette._note: Colour roles for every mod overlay: campfire at night. Panels are warm near-black (the cards' world), secondary text is warm grey derived from them, gold is the campfire accent. Row consts refer to a role as "@name". Contrast (worst case: panel over snow): text, textSoft, muted, good, accent, callout pass 4.5:1 on every surface; faint and bad pass only on surfaceStrong and on card faces, so use them nowhere else. Green/red never carry meaning alone: card lines and Current Build stats carry + / - markers.

rows.visual: MenuWindow (blocksPlayerInput, showCursorWhileOpen) with a dark backdrop: YOUR DECK. The deck expands from a pile into a fan of full card faces (rows of up to Fan.MaxPerRow, scaled to fit the band between the subtitle and the totals panel); under the fan, ALL CARDS ADDED UP on a dark panel: the combined stats from the live Effects fold in two balanced columns, with + / - markers, on-now and off-now marks, the difficulty strength line, and FROM TEAMMATES auras. Clicking a card pulls it out: the card enlarged on the left, a detail panel on the right (rarity and name, benefit, drawback, every conditional modifier marked active or not right now, its charge or cooldown, aura reach, when it was picked, flavour), with < and > arrows that flip through the deck. The Deck key steps to TEAM DECKS: every other player as a small pile of card backs in their rarity colours (name, card count and state (passed out / ghost), Clown Luggage penalties above it, a count chip on the pile); clicking a deck fans that player’s cards out as card faces in pick order with ALL CARDS ADDED UP (their always-on combined stats and a situational count) on a panel beneath; the key again closes the screen

rows.behaviour: opened with the Deck key on the island (or by clicking the DeckHud pile); the key then steps to TEAM DECKS (with teammates in the run) and a third press closes, from the team views alike; Esc and a backdrop click back out one step instead (pulled card -> fan, a teammate’s fanned cards -> the team decks, anything else closes), and the pause menu never opens over this screen: Esc raises Pause and UICancel together, the window consumes both, and hooks.json pausePressed catches what still reaches LateUpdate (a controller Start press). Closed by a pick fan opening or leaving the run. The fan expands from the pile centre over expandSeconds with cardStaggerSeconds between cards. Totals and the pulled card’s detail refresh 4 times a second from the live Effects fold and Core.BuildStats, never recomputed in the UI. Controller: the first card (or deck pile) is selected on open, grid navigation, confirm pulls a card out or opens a pile, < and > flip, cancel backs out.

rows.behaviour: opened with the BugReport key (config Keys, default F9) on the island; the game's windowBlockingInput silences movement and every other mod key while it is open, so typing never walks the scout off a cliff. Esc, cancel or a backdrop click closes it (the draft is kept; pauseWasPressed is consumed so the pause menu never opens on top). Send builds the payload (versions, scene, deck ids, room size, categories, comment, and the scrubbed log tail when the checkbox is on), posts it to the configured endpoint (Reporting.Endpoint), and falls back to a local file in the plugin folder when the post fails or no endpoint is set.
